dataset.corpus_definition: All usable clips in accessible nonduplicate public archives passing the declared SportVU integrity and corrected-shot physical filters; not the whole NBA season or sensor-clean ground truth.

illustrative_policy.claims: Geometric trajectory similarity only; ball context only; untimed topK diagnostics, no tactical-semantic or top5 timing claims.
illustrative_policy.difficult: worst top1 quality rank including empty answers
illustrative_policy.median: median top1 quality rank including empty answers ranked last
illustrative_policy.optional_best: smallest exact optimal distance, labelled as selected
illustrative_policy.primary: hash-first test query, regardless of outcome
illustrative_policy.results: candidate-reranked top1 and next-ranked candidate from a different database game, with actual rank displayed

manifest.timing_scope: top1 only; candidate topK diagnostic reranking is outside all query timers

notes: Results are full validated-accessible-corpus measurements, not the whole NBA season.
Every query game is held out of database and tuning.
Index-array storage and total RAM are distinct; achieved quality accompanies latency.
Accuracy intervals resample held-out games, preserving their query and index-seed dependence.
Absolute distance and excess distance in feet do not certify tactical similarity.
Any missing or deadline-failed seed group has no headline aggregate performance.
